title: PhLynx physiology template
description: A scaffold of cells, membrane facets, process areas and compartments for the physiological view. Each piece offers a site that a library module can be dropped onto. Keys this schema does not list are ignored with a warning.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editors. Ignored by PhLynx.

schemaVersion.description: The template format version. Must be 1.

id.description: The template's id: a lower-case letter, then lower-case letters, digits and hyphens (2-48 characters).

description.description: A sentence or two on what the template shows.

license.description: The template's licence, as an SPDX identifier such as CC0-1.0.

cells.description: The cells, laid out in rows in declaration order.

compartments.description: The fluid compartments around the cells. Several against the same facet stack outward in declaration order.

pieceId.description: A piece's id: a lower-case letter, then lower-case letters, digits and hyphens (1-32 characters).

site.description: Set to false to offer no site on this piece. Pieces offer a site by default.

cell.description: A cell: its body is a cytosol site, its membrane a membrane site, each facet a row of membrane protein slots and each process a row of cytosolic slots.

id.description: The cell's id, unique among cells and compartments.

row.description: The row the cell sits in, counting down from 0. Defaults to 0.

size.description: The cell's smallest drawn size, in pixels. Defaults to 320 by 240.

membrane.description: The cell's membrane as a whole, or false for no membrane site. Defaults to a plasma membrane.

facets.description: The parts of the membrane that hold membrane proteins; at most one per edge.

processes.description: Areas inside the cell that hold cytosolic processes.

site.description: Set to false to offer no site on this piece.

facet.description: A part of a cell's membrane along one edge.

id.description: The facet's id, unique within its cell; 'membrane' is reserved.

edge.description: The edge of the cell the facet lies along.

group.description: Facets in the same group share the proteins that do not name a side, such as the two sides of the lateral membrane.

annotation.description: The annotated facet (ApiCoord) this facet stands for, so annotated proteins land on it.

at.description: Which side of the lateral facet; only for the lateral facet.

site.description: Set to false to offer no site on this piece.

process.description: An area inside a cell for cytosolic processes.

id.description: The process's id, unique within its cell; 'membrane' is reserved.

site.description: Set to false to offer no site on this piece.

compartment.description: A fluid compartment outside the cells; its body is a region site.

id.description: The compartment's id, unique among cells and compartments.

against.description: The facets the compartment lies against, as 'cell.facet': facets on the same top or bottom edge of cells in one row (a band), two facing facets of neighbouring cells (the gap between them), one left or right facet (a column), or none (a free band below everything).

tone.description: The compartment's colour. Defaults to sky.

depth.description: How far the compartment reaches out from the facets, in pixels. Leave it out for the usual depth.

site.description: Set to false to offer no site on this piece.
